title: Analysis seal
description:
What the analysis wrote, recorded per object so a later pass can be held to the fields it owns. The named producer is seal-analysis, a script; the named consumer is check-enrichment, which recomputes each digest and reports what moved. This artifact drives control flow — a consumer decides from it whether an enrichment stayed inside its fields — so it is a versioned schema validated at the boundary rather than prose.

It exists because the enrichment boundary has to be checkable against *something*, and re-deriving what was written is only possible while a deterministic script writes it. A producer that authors by judgment cannot be re-run to yield the same bytes, so what it wrote is recorded once, immediately, by something other than itself: a guarantee a producer self-reports is not a guarantee.

Per field rather than per file. A whole-file digest answers whether an object moved and not which part of it did, and a report that cannot name the field leaves a reader to diff by hand — recoverability and diagnosability are the first criterion, not a convenience.

contract_version.description: The contract this instance declares. A consumer selects behaviour on this value and never infers a version from shape.

producer.description: The named producer, closed rather than a free string. One value, because a seal any other capability could write would be a seal the pass it constrains could write about itself.

consumer.description: Who reads it. Nothing else parses a seal, and a second consumer would be a second place the ownership line is interpreted.

objects.description: One entry per object the analysis wrote, keyed by its path relative to the root that was sealed. Relative because a seal recorded with absolute paths would be a seal only the machine that wrote it could read.

fields.description: A digest per frontmatter field the analysis owns. The fields a later pass writes are absent by construction: sealing them would record a value nobody had written yet and report every legitimate enrichment as a change.

domain_gaps.description: Every `kind: domain` gap, verbatim rather than digested. A removed one has to be reported by the field it named, and a digest names nothing a reader can open.

headings.description: The body headings the analysis placed, in order. The enrichment fills them and adds none: a third heading is one the object contract refuses.
